subject: Banking
title: The Bank of Japan's Experiment
description: A quick, practical guide to The Bank of Japan's Experiment.

hook.text: Japan has fought deflation for 30 years. The Bank of Japan tried zero rates, negative rates, and QE.

buildup.text: Japan's bubble burst in 1990. Prices and wages stagnated for decades.

discovery.text: The BOJ pioneered QE in 2001, before any other central bank.

twist.text: The BOJ owns over 50% of Japanese government bonds. It effectively funds the government by buying its debt.

climax.text: Japan showed what happens when deflation takes hold. Central banks can create money but can't always create inflation.

punchline.text: 30 years of deflation. Japan proved money printing has limits.

quiz.question: What percentage of Japanese government bonds does the BOJ own?
